name: Tract Analysis Profiles
summary: Computes tract profiles of tensor (FA, MD, RD, AD), DKI, NODDI, myelin or quantitative MRI measures along segmented white matter tracts with Vistasoft, producing profile plots and a tractmeasures CSV.
description: Samples diffusion tensor (AD, FA, MD, RD), and optionally DKI, NODDI (NDI, ISOVF, ODI), myelin-map or qMRI (T1, R1, M0, PD, MTV, VIP, SIR, WF) measures along each tract of a white matter classification (wmc) at numnodes evenly spaced nodes, weighting streamlines by their distance from the tract core (Vistasoft dtiComputeDiffusionPropertiesAlongFG) or, when fiberbased is true, without weighting (Compute_FA_AlongFG). Produces PNG/EPS profile plots per tract and measure and a tractmeasures CSV with means and standard deviations. Use it after tract segmentation; it needs the wmc and the whole-brain tck it was derived from. At least one of tensor, NODDI or myelin inputs must be provided.

citations.text: Yeatman JD, Dougherty RF, Myall NJ, Wandell BA, Feldman HM (2012) Tract Profiles of White Matter Properties: Automating Fiber-Tract Quantification. PLoS ONE 7(11): e49790.

failure_modes.cause: The number of profile images differs from the number expected (numfiles.txt).
failure_modes.fix: Check the log for tracts with too few streamlines or missing measure files.
